get_time_discretization_default: get EDM time discretization samples for a given number of function evaluations using default rho=7
get_time_discretization_custom_rho: get EDM time discretization samples with a custom rho parameter for diffusion model sampling schedules
get_time_discretization_cifar10: get time discretization steps optimized for CIFAR-10 image generation using the EDM sampling schedule
get_time_discretization_tensor_output: get a PyTorch tensor of time samples from 0 to 1 for use in flow matching or diffusion models
get_time_discretization_sigma_mapping: get time samples derived from sigma values mapped through the EDM noise schedule transformation
